import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,json,hashlib,glob,subprocess,sys,re
lane=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
ids=json.loads((lane/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']
want=set(ids)
paths=sorted(glob.glob('/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus/mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl'))
print('chunks',len(paths))
found={}
keys=None
for p in paths:
    data=pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()
    ch=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    off=0
    for ln,raw in enumerate(data.split(b'\n')[:-1] if data.endswith(b'\n') else data.split(b'\n'),1):
        pass
    lines=data.splitlines(keepends=True)
    for ln,raw in enumerate(lines,1):
        s=raw.rstrip(b'\n')
        try: o=json.loads(s)
        except Exception: continue
        i=o.get('mathdb_id') or o.get('id')
        try: i=int(i)
        except Exception: continue
        if i in want:
            if keys is None: keys=sorted(o.keys()); print('KEYS',keys)
            found[i]=dict(chunk=p,chunk_sha256=ch,line=ln,raw_with_newline_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),raw_no_newline_sha256=hashlib.sha256(s).hexdigest(),has_newline=raw.endswith(b'\n'),raw=s.decode('utf8'),obj=o)
print('found',len(found),sorted(want-set(found)))
stmtkey=[k for k in keys if 'statement' in k.lower()]
print('stmt keys',stmtkey)
out={}
for i in ids:
    r=found[i]; o=r['obj']
    k='statement' if 'statement' in o else stmtkey[0]
    # raw token
    needle=('"%s":'%k).encode()
    rawb=r['raw'].encode('utf8')
    idx=rawb.find(needle)
    if idx<0:
        needle=('"%s": '%k).encode(); idx=rawb.find(needle)
    start=rawb.find(b'"',idx+len(needle))
    j=start+1
    while True:
        c=rawb[j:j+1]
        if c==b'\\': j+=2; continue
        if c==b'"': break
        j+=1
    token=rawb[start:j+1]
    dec=json.loads(token)
    assert dec==o[k]
    out[str(i)]=dict(chunk_path=r['chunk'],chunk_sha256=r['chunk_sha256'],one_based_line=r['line'],raw_line_with_newline_sha256=r['raw_with_newline_sha256'],raw_line_without_newline_sha256=r['raw_no_newline_sha256'],has_trailing_newline=r['has_newline'],raw_line=r['raw'],statement_key=k,raw_statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest(),raw_statement_token_len=len(token),decoded_statement=dec,decoded_statement_utf8_sha256=hashlib.sha256(dec.encode('utf8')).hexdigest())
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'corpus-bindings.json'],input=json.dumps(out,indent=1,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True)
print('writer',w.returncode,w.stdout,w.stderr)
for i in ids[:7]:
    r=found[i]; print('-----',i,r['line'],r['has_newline'],len(r['raw']))
    print(out[str(i)]['decoded_statement'])

    print('META',{k:(v if len(str(v))<300 else str(v)[:300]) for k,v in o.items() if k not in ('statement',)})
